## Ask the map first

Run from the repository root. Use the complete catalogue for all entry points,
components, relationships, workflows, evidence and inventory details.

| Question | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Owner, definitions and references | `python scripts/project_map.py q <path or symbol>` |
| Related defect instances | `python scripts/project_map.py class <path or symbol>` |
| Tests | `python scripts/project_map.py tests <path>` |
| Change impact | `python scripts/project_map.py impact <path>` |
| Content search | `python scripts/project_map.py grep <pattern>` |
| Definitions and sections | `python scripts/project_map.py outline <path>` |
| Exact source | `python scripts/project_map.py show <path>:<name>` |
| Project summary | `python scripts/project_map.py brief` |

Rebuild: `python scripts/project_map.py build`.
Verify: `python scripts/project_map.py check`.
